tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Human account; local bootstrap or future federated identity

tables.name: auth_identities
tables.purpose: Federated/local subject mapping; never provider inference credentials
columns: Verified issuer or local OS bootstrap namespace
constraints: UNIQUE (issuer, subject)

tables.name: tenants
tables.purpose: Isolation boundary and account namespace

tables.name: tenant_memberships
tables.purpose: Human membership and role in one tenant
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: projects
tables.purpose: Trusted graph routing and project lifecycle
columns: Restore incarnation; shared with graph ProjectRoot
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, slug)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: project_memberships
tables.purpose: Project role; tenant membership is a prerequisite
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: user_sessions
tables.purpose: Human application authentication; distinct from agent sessions
columns: Hash of random bearer token; never plaintext
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
CHECK (idle_expires_at <= expires_at)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id, id)

tables.name: worker_hosts
tables.purpose: Enrolled execution host; local first
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: provider_accounts
tables.purpose: Nonsecret native or API route metadata for one human
columns: API or app-owned OAuth secret-store reference; never token bytes
Native profile reference; no auth cache content
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
CHECK (auth_route <> 'native' OR secret_ref IS NULL)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: provider_profiles
tables.purpose: Project-selectable versioned execution settings
columns: Nonsecret validated settings including endpoint if selected
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, owner_user_id, provider_account_id) REFERENCES provider_accounts(tenant_id, user_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: workspace_registrations
tables.purpose: Authorized worktree/snapshot binding to a project and host
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, host_id) REFERENCES worker_hosts(tenant_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, host_id, canonical_path)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: runs
tables.purpose: Run index and immutable admitted policy; current authority in graph Run
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, initial_profile_id) REFERENCES provider_profiles(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, initiated_by) REFERENCES project_memberships(tenant_id, project_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: agent_sessions
tables.purpose: One actual runtime instance; fresh successors get new identities
columns: External graph Task ID; not SQL FK
Role-specific authority, no shared Builder claim
Immutable graph epoch, task, role, candidate, criteria and reservation binding
Must match graph session and launch contract
Observed process lifecycle; not task state
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, run_id) REFERENCES runs(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, profile_id) REFERENCES provider_profiles(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace_registrations(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, run_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, run_id, parent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, run_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: native_bindings
tables.purpose: Native thread/session correlation per resume/launch binding
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, native_runtime, native_session_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: launch_attempts
tables.purpose: Observed runtime registration attempts; process identity only for actual external runtime
columns: External runtime process identifier; null for in-process Builder
Start-time/boot identity prevents PID reuse confusion
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, host_id) REFERENCES worker_hosts(tenant_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, launch_graph_id, attempt_no)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: artifacts
tables.purpose: Immutable content metadata; bytes are project-scoped external objects
columns: log / patch / snapshot / context / corpus / checkpoint
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, owner_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
CHECK ((visibility='project') OR (visibility='user' AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (visibility='session' AND owner_session_id IS NOT NULL))
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, storage_key)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: capture_events
tables.purpose: Immutable normalized visible observation, authoritative before graph ingestion
columns: message / tool / lifecycle / approval / usage / gap
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, raw_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, source_key)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, capture_seq)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: session_messages
tables.purpose: Ordered visible user/assistant/tool text; graph Message anchors cite these
columns: Large content object instead of inline body
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, capture_event_id) REFERENCES capture_events(tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, body_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
CHECK ((body IS NULL) <> (body_artifact_id IS NULL))
CHECK (visibility <> 'user' OR owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, message_seq)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: tool_executions
tables.purpose: Observed external tool action and effect certainty
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, capture_event_id) REFERENCES capture_events(tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, input_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, output_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, runtime_call_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: tool_approvals
tables.purpose: One scoped native approval request and user response
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, tool_execution_id) REFERENCES tool_executions(tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, decided_by) REFERENCES project_memberships(tenant_id, project_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, runtime_request_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: capture_gaps
tables.purpose: Explicit unobserved interval; never synthesize missing content
columns: Next known boundary; null if open
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
CHECK (to_seq IS NULL OR to_seq >= from_seq)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: capture_outbox
tables.purpose: SQL-to-graph delivery; payload resides in capture event
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, capture_event_id) REFERENCES capture_events(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, capture_event_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, operation_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: graph_event_projection
tables.purpose: Replayable SQL copy of committed graph Events
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, graph_epoch, event_seq)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, graph_epoch, event_graph_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: projection_offsets
tables.purpose: Cursor advanced atomically with projection rows
constraints: UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, consumer_name)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: context_packets
tables.purpose: Immutable rendered packet; graph ContextPacket owns inclusion relationships
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, content_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: context_deliveries
tables.purpose: Transport insertion evidence; graph ACK is acceptance authority
columns: Stable application ID for one packet insertion into one turn
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, context_packet_id) REFERENCES context_packets(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, submission_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: usage_ledger
tables.purpose: Observed usage; graph owns admission/reservations
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, source_key)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: audit_events
tables.purpose: Security/configuration audit; exclude secrets and full private prompts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, actor_user_id) REFERENCES tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.purpose: Reference migration inventory; application and graph compatibility checked separately
constraints: UNIQUE (store, version)

tables.name: project_messages
tables.purpose: Human goals and requirement changes captured independently of agent execution
columns: Optional run; goal may precede run creation
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, author_user_id) REFERENCES project_memberships(tenant_id, project_id, user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, author_user_id, user_session_id) REFERENCES user_sessions(tenant_id, user_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, run_id) REFERENCES runs(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, request_id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: provider_oauth_registrations
tables.purpose: Optional app-owned ChatGPT registration metadata; credentials remain in secret store
columns: Issued account/workspace-bound registration; never bootstrap ID
Stable installation identifier; not a secret
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, user_id, provider_account_id) REFERENCES provider_accounts(tenant_id, user_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, host_id) REFERENCES worker_hosts(tenant_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, provider_account_id, host_id, client_id)
CHECK (client_id <> 'dynamic_agent_client')
UNIQUE (tenant_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id)

tables.name: command_inbox
tables.purpose: Durable human command envelope and graph-admission retry journal
columns: Exact authored goal or requirement source
Expected authority incarnation; never silently rebound
Complete immutable normalized command including expected revisions
Durable admission outcome; pending is not accepted authority
Accepted sequence in the bound epoch
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, initiated_by) REFERENCES project_memberships(tenant_id, project_id, user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, initiated_by, user_session_id) REFERENCES user_sessions(tenant_id, user_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, source_message_id) REFERENCES project_messages(tenant_id, project_id, id)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, request_id)
CHECK (status <> 'committed' OR (graph_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND graph_event_seq IS NOT NULL AND settled_at IS NOT NULL))
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)

tables.name: model_requests
tables.purpose: One durable provider transport attempt within a stable logical turn
columns: Stable logical inference request; retries retain this ID
Explicit transport attempt; each may be billed
Exact applicable graph context packet when present
Protected exact supported provider input without credentials
Pinned effective provider capabilities and parameters
M02 migration 3: durable admitted estimate; NULL on legacy rows
M02 migration 3: observed transport uncertainty; NULL means legacy unknown
Provider correlation if available; not assumed resumable
Completed visible normalized response and supported opaque state
Observed usage row in same session; absent means unknown
Durable dispatch intent time; not proof provider received request
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, profile_id) REFERENCES provider_profiles(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, context_packet_id) REFERENCES context_packets(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, input_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, response_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, usage_source_key) REFERENCES usage_ledger(tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, source_key)
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, agent_session_id, logical_request_id, attempt_no)
CHECK (status <> 'completed' OR (response_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL))
UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(tenant_id, id)
